registration: Local protocol fixed before development collection; not external preregistration.
pd_baseline: Per-foot linear logistic contact-state model: current leg q,dq, unsaturated PD torque proxy, finite-difference dq; no measured contact or actual torque input.
target: Qualified landing after >=40ms <=5N, two consecutive >5N native samples. Severity maximum causal20ms-average positive20ms-lag derivative during40ms after onset; strong iff >2000N/s. Same definition as observability_v1, not all stance impacts.
continuous_target: Severity (MSE, divided by2000) or strong-landing indicator (BCE) in [onset,onset+40ms), zero otherwise. Features at boundary t include only pre[t] and five earlier frames of the same episode.
oracle: Privileged diagnostic fires at ceil((native_onset+2)/8), after the second high force sample. No offline early onset access.
gate: State/PD hysteresis: arm after two consecutive p<high/2 packets, fire at p>=high, require100ms refractory; pulse gate uses100ms quiet rule. Fit thresholds on validation seen-family tile_id%3==0 by onset F1.
alarm: At t alarm iff score[t]>=threshold and previous five same-episode scores are all <threshold. Shared100ms quiet rule. Gated severity is evaluated once per gate pulse.
alarm_thresholds: 128 score quantiles plus disabled; maximize recall subject to validation role1 tile-bootstrap95% upper FAR <=0.5 per robot-minute. Separate thresholds per method and delay; role2 verifies without selection.

primary.rule: Average two initializations per data replication; paired t95% CI over five replications, lower >.03 AND both methods test FAR upper <=1/min. One superiority endpoint; negative outcome allowed.

practical_feasibility: State-gated BCE normal-seen recall lower >=.7 AND FAR upper<=1/min in all four speed/terrain conditions. Not a safety guarantee.
uncertainty: Data-replication CIs plus tile bootstrap; shared tiles are not independent environments. Poisson zero-count upper bound reported only as an assumption-dependent diagnostic.
storage: One raw role staged at a time; retain models, event tables, sparse alarm records, full-input64-env fixtures and21-env native-force audits. Archive/readback verification precedes deletion of this stage's bulk pre/dense caches. Do not restore old bulk data.
